content:
The v4.20.1 release of Lean is here!

The Lean v4.20.0 release brings multiple new features, bug fixes, improvements to Lake, and groundwork for the module system. v4.20.1 additionally contains a fix that improves compatibility with the repl package; users of repl are advised to use v4.20.1 as their stable version, or the latest release candidate.

Please read the release notes for details.

Mathlib and repl are now available for v4.20.1:

  • there is a v4.20.1 tag in each repository if you would like to pin to a commit using this toolchain.

Batteries, Aesop, ProofWidgets, and Mathlib are all now available for v4.20.0:

  • there is a v4.20.0 tag in each repository if you would like to pin to a commit using this toolchain.
